findings.summary: Fund list shows minus percentages that read like losses, and nothing next to the number explains what it means.
Comparison amounts in ₪ have a minus sign where a loss would go, which is alarming until the reader works out it means 'less than the top one'.
The calculator starts with default inputs (10,000 + 500), so the first big result isn't the user's own and sticks in memory.
Every bank row repeats the same grey 'לא בחישוב' box, which the reader has to skip past each time.
The fee colours are explained once in a legend on screen 3, so the reader has to scroll back to match bar colours in later ranking rows.
'18 ₪ יותר' and '1,390 ₪ פחות' sit side by side, and it's unclear which one is good for the user.
Fund cards repeat the same tags (קרן סל, מחזיקה את המניות), which are cut off at the left edge.
